info.description:
# ✨ Google Custom Doodle

Replace Google's logo with **any GIF or image** while keeping Google's clean interface.

## Features

✅ Custom GIF or image

✅ Google Home

✅ Google Search

✅ Adjustable Home logo scale

✅ Adjustable Search logo scale

✅ Adjustable Search position (X/Y)

✅ Hover animation

✅ Lightweight

✅ Compatible with Stylish / Stylus

---

## Appearance Options

? **Custom Logo**

Upload any GIF, PNG, JPG or WebP.

? **Home Scale**

Resize the logo on Google's homepage.

? **Search Scale**

Resize the logo shown on search pages.

↔ **Search Offset X**

Move the search logo horizontally.

↕ **Search Offset Y**

Move the search logo vertically.

✨ **Search Hover Scale**

Change how much the logo enlarges when hovering.

---

## Recommended GIF size

Home:
500×200

Search:
92×33 (the style scales automatically)

Transparent GIFs are recommended.

---

Made with ❤️ by Akai.
info.additionalInfo: Replace Google's logo with any GIF or image. Supports Home and Search pages with customizable size and position.
